targets.queryText:
WITH latest AS (
                SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
                FROM technology_snapshots
                WHERE scope_key='europe:data-engineer'
                  AND country_code=${country:sqlstring}
                  AND requirement_type='required'
            ), top AS (
                SELECT technology
                FROM technology_snapshots
                WHERE scope_key='europe:data-engineer'
                  AND country_code=${country:sqlstring}
                  AND requirement_type='required'
                  AND captured_at=(SELECT captured_at FROM latest)
                ORDER BY vacancy_count DESC, technology
                LIMIT 10
            )
            SELECT datetime(ts.captured_at) AS time,
                   ts.technology AS metric,
                   ts.vacancy_count AS value
            FROM technology_snapshots ts
            JOIN top ON top.technology=ts.technology
            WHERE ts.scope_key='europe:data-engineer'
              AND ts.country_code=${country:sqlstring}
              AND ts.requirement_type='required'
            ORDER BY ts.captured_at, ts.technology

WITH latest AS (

            ), top AS (

                  AND country_code=${country:sqlstring}
                  AND requirement_type='required'
                  AND captured_at=(SELECT captured_at FROM latest)
                ORDER BY vacancy_count DESC, technology
                LIMIT 10
            )
            SELECT datetime(ts.captured_at) AS time,
                   ts.technology AS metric,
                   ts.vacancy_count AS value
            FROM technology_snapshots ts
            JOIN top ON top.technology=ts.technology
            WHERE ts.scope_key='europe:data-engineer'
              AND ts.country_code=${country:sqlstring}
              AND ts.requirement_type='required'
            ORDER BY ts.captured_at, ts.technology

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Required, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'preferred' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Preferred, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'alternative' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Alternative, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'mentioned' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Mentioned FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Required DESC, Preferred DESC LIMIT 30
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Required, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'preferred' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Preferred, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'alternative' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Alternative, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'mentioned' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Mentioned FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Required DESC, Preferred DESC LIMIT 30

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, jt.requirement_type AS Type, e.title AS Vacancy, e.company AS Company, jt.section AS Section, jt.evidence_text AS Evidence, e.canonical_url AS URL FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${requirement:sqlstring} = '__all' OR jt.requirement_type = ${requirement:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE jt.requirement_type WHEN 'required' THEN 1 WHEN 'preferred' THEN 2 WHEN 'alternative' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, e.published_at DESC LIMIT 100
